title: Bleach
source: Bleach manga by Tite Kubo (686 chapters), up to the epilogue ten years after the Thousand-Year Blood War.
world: Karakura Town teenager Ichigo Kurosaki gains the powers of a Soul Reaper (Shinigami) and protects the living from Hollows, evil spirits. The afterlife city Soul Society is guarded by the Gotei 13, thirteen divisions led by captains. The story moves through the rescue of Rukia, Aizen's betrayal and the Arrancar war, and the Thousand-Year Blood War against the Quincy. Cool swords, stylish fights and loyalty between friends define its tone.
power_system: Soul Reapers fight with zanpakuto, living swords with a released form (Shikai) and a stronger final form (Bankai), powered by spiritual pressure (reiatsu). Hollows wear masks; Arrancar are Hollows who removed them. Quincy use bows of spirit energy. Kido are spells.

timeline.summary: Ichigo gets Rukia's powers and fights Hollows.
Ichigo and friends invade to save Rukia; Aizen betrays Soul Society and leaves with Gin and Tosen.
Aizen's Espada attack; Orihime is taken to Hueco Mundo and rescued.
Ichigo defeats Aizen with the Final Getsuga Tensho and loses his powers; Aizen is sealed.
Yhwach's Quincy invade; Aizen is freed to help; Ichigo strikes down Yhwach.
Ten years later Ichigo and Orihime are married with a son, Kazui.
